name_ar: فرز أعطال الاتصال حسب مجال الخطأ دون تغيير الإعدادات
name_en: Fault-domain connectivity triage without touching config
what: يحدد مكان عطل الشبكة (الشبكة المحلية، DNS، المسار، الخدمة نفسها) بأقل الأدلة وبأوامر قراءة فقط. — Localises a live connectivity failure to LAN, DNS, upstream path or the remote service with bounded, read-only probes.
when: API أو خادم MCP ينقطع، DNS متقلب، فقدان حزم / an API or MCP server times out, DNS is flaky, calls drop packets
how: 1) Record the exact affected host/URL, start time, continuous or intermittent, and whether other sites work. 2) Compare a 5-packet ping to a known local target with one to the destination (never invent a gateway). 3) Separate resolver configuration (scutil --dns / resolvectl) from query behaviour (dig +time=2 +tries=1). 4) Bounded traceroute -n -q 1 -m 20 only if path visibility reduces doubt; a silent hop is not a broken hop. 5) Time the real endpoint with curl -w dns/connect/tls/ttfb/total and timeouts. 6) Label each line Observed / Inferred / Unknown and return one fault domain with low/medium/high confidence plus the single next safest check; no restarts, DNS flushes or firewall edits during diagnosis.
